And the Centurion and they that were vvith him vvatching <sc>IESVS</sc>, hauing seen the earth-quake and the things that vvere done, vvere sore afraid, saying, In deede this vvas the sonne of God.
And there vvere there many vvomen a farre of, vvhich had folovved <sc>IESVS</sc> from Galilee, ministring vnto him:
among vvhom vvas Marie Magdalene, and Marie the mother of Iames and Ioseph, and the mother of the sonnes of Zebedee.
<na>[1]</na> And vvhen it vvas euening, there came a certaine rich man of Arimathaea, named Ioseph, vvho also him self was disciple to <sc>IESVS</sc>.

notes.text: HORA VESPERARVM, or, Euensong.

verses.text: He went to Pilate, and asked the body of <sc>IESVS</sc>. Then Pilate commaunded that the body should be deliuered.
<na>[1]</na> And Ioseph taking the body, vvrapt it in cleane sindon,

notes.text: HORA COMPLETORII, or Complin.

verses.text: and laid it in his ovvne nevve monument, vvhich he had hevved out in a rocke. And he rolled a great stone to the doore of the monument, and vvent his vvay.
And there was there Marie Magdalene, and the other Marie, sitting ouer against the sepulchre.
<na>[1]</na> And the next day, vvhich is after the Parasceue, the cheefe Priestes and the Pharisees came together to Pilate,

notes.text: SATVRDAY called Sabbatum sanctum.

verses.text: saying, Sir, we haue remembred, that that seducer said yet liuing, After three dayes I wil rise againe.

Commaund therfore the sepulchre to be kept vntil the third day: lest perhaps his Disciples come, and steale him, and say to the people, He is risen from the dead: and the last errour shal be vvorse then the first.
Pilate said to them, You haue a gard: goe, gard it as you knovv.
And they departing, made the sepulchre sure: sealing vp the stone, vvith vvatchmen.

chapters.summary: The cheefe of the Iewes accuse him to Pilate the Gentil (his betrayer, and the Iudge, and the Iudges wife, testifying in the meane time manifodly his innocencie:) 20 and persuade the common people also not only to preferre the murderer Barabbas, but also to crie, Crucifige: (Al, to the reprobation of their whole nation, and nothing but fulfilling the Scriptures.) 27 After many illusions, 31 he is crucified by the Gentils. 38 Which the Iewes seeing, do triumph as if they had now the victorie. 45 But euen then by many wonderful workes he declareth his might, to their confusion 57 Finally being buried, they to make al sure, set souldiars to keepe his sepulcher.

verses.text: <sc>AND</sc> <cr>[1]</cr><na>[2]</na><na>[3]</na> in the euening of the Sabboth vvhich davvneth on the first of the Sabboth, came Marie Magdalene, and the other Marie to see the sepulchre.

notes.text: The Gospel for the night Masse of Christes Resurrection, which is now vsed to be said on Easter eue in the morning.
EASTER day.

verses.text: And behold there vvas made a great earth-quake. For an Angel of our Lord descended from heauen: and comming, rolled backe the stone, and sate vpon it:
and his countenance vvas as lightening: and his garment as snovv.
And for feare of him, the vvatchmen vvere frighted, and became as dead.
And the Angel ansvvering said to the vvomen, Feare not you. for I know that you seeke <sc>IESVS</sc> that vvas crucified.
he is not here: for he is risen, <cr>[1]</cr> as he said. come, and see the place vvhere our Lord vvas laid.
And going quickly, tel ye his Disciples that he is risen: and behold he goeth before you into Galilee. there you shal see him. loe I haue fortold you.
And they vvent forth quickly out of the monument vvith feare and great ioy, running to tel his Disciples.
And behold <sc>IESVS</sc> mette them, saying, Al haile. But they came neere and tooke hold of his feete, and adored him.
Then <sc>IESVS</sc> said to them, Feare not. goe, tel my brethren that they goe into Galilee, there they shal see me.
Who vvhen they vvere departed, behold certaine of the watchmen came into the citie, and told the cheefe Priestes al things that had been done.
And being assembled together vvith the auncients, taking counsel, they gaue a greate summe of money to the souldiars,
saying, Say you, That his Disciples came by night, and stole him avvay vvhen vve were a sleepe.
And if the President shal heare of this, vve vvil persuade him, and make you secure.
But they taking the money, did as they vvere taught. And this vvord vvas bruited abrode among the Ievves, euen vnto this day.
<na>[1]</na> And the eleuen Disciples vvent into Galilee, vnto the mount vvhere <sc>IESVS</sc> had appointed them.

notes.text: The Gospel vpon Friday in Easter weeke.

verses.text: And seeing him they adored, but some doubted.
<na>[1]</na> And <sc>IESVS</sc> comming neere spake vnto them, saying. Al povver is giuen to me in heauen and in earth.

notes.text: The Gospel in the feast of the B. Trinitie.

verses.text: going therfore teach ye al nations: <sc>BAPTIZING THEM IN THE NAME OF THE FATHER AND OF THE SONNE AND OF THE HOLY GHOST</sc>,
teaching them to obserue al things vvhatsoeuer I haue commaunded you, and behold I am vvith you al daies, euen to the consummation of the vvorld. ⊢

chapters.summary: He riseth againe the third day, and (the blind most obstinate Iewes by bribery working to their owne reprobation) he appeareth to his Disciples in Galilee (as both before his Passion he foretold them Mat. 26, and now after his Resurrection, first the Angel, then also him self appointed by the women) 18 and sendeth them to al Nations, to build his Church among ehe Gentils.
